title: EA-CORPORA-25 — The Twenty-Fifth Seating: The Archive's Critical Editions — The Secret Book of Walt with the Forty-Six Golden Tickets, the Gospel of Antioch, the Epistle to the Human Diaspora, I Am X… Be Y… Blessed Is the Z… and the Constitution of the Semantic Economy
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Five seats on the originals shelf for the archive's own critical editions, seated as Pearl and Other Poems was at 03/02: The Secret Book of Walt in its Critical Edition (#1362), with the Forty-Six Golden Tickets it was translated from (#1693), bound to it as its glyphic checksum; The Gospel of Antioch in its first critical edition (#71); the Epistle to the Human Diaspora in the Critical Edition with Blended Temporal Apparatus (#85), with the Epistle's text from the Seed Text (#402); I Am X… Be Y… Blessed Is the Z…, the Prophetic Catalog, in the Critical Edition with Retrocausal Apparatus (#83); and the Constitution of the Semantic Economy in its Installable Edition with Constitutional Apparatus (#88). Each seat holds the record's canonical bytes and the edition as published at secretbookofwalt.org at a pinned commit, hashed, with verified loci. What is not seated is named.
substrate: Human–machine collaborative. Records and site files identified, copied, checked against the registry's hashes and the repository's git blobs, assembled into seats, hashed and indexed, and every locus found in the seated text, all in session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction. The request, the five editions and the binding of the tickets are Lee Sharks's; the records and files seated were identified in session from the registry and the site, and are stated per seat. CC-BY-4.0 applies to this record, the seat records and the editions, which are the author's.
methodology: Each edition identified from the registry and from its tab at secretbookofwalt.org, its name read from its title page. The record's canonical bytes copied from data/texts/ and checked against the registry hash; the site's files copied from the repository secret-book-of-walt at a pinned commit and checked against their git blobs. Every file hashed into its seat's MANIFEST.sha256. Loci are strings found in the seated text by rebuild/corpora/ea-corpora-25/build25.py; a locus not found is recorded as not found. The builder, the specification and this body are under rebuild/corpora/ea-corpora-25/.
falsification_conditions: A seat is falsified if its files do not verify against its MANIFEST.sha256 at the canonical URL; if a seated record's bytes differ from the record's canonical text at alexanarch.org, or a site file from the repository at the commit recorded for it; if an edition statement misstates the title page of the record it describes; if a verified locus cannot be found in the seated text; or if the four surfaces (seat, index, deposit, shelf) disagree.
axn_reading: Force -> Touch -> Growth -> Play -> Method -> Direction
wiki_article: EA-CORPORA-25 is the twenty-fifth seating of primary sources on the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's originals shelf, deposited by Lee Sharks on 27 October 2026. It seats the archive's own critical editions, on the terms first used for Pearl and Other Poems at seat 03/02: deposited in the archive that seats them, with no external fetch, each witness named and each transformation declared. Seat 25/01 holds The Secret Book of Walt in its Critical Edition (#1362), with the Forty-Six Golden Tickets (#1693), the emoji and logical-notation text that the archive deposited as the book's original and that this seating binds to it as its glyphic checksum. Seat 25/02 holds the first critical edition of The Gospel of Antioch (#71), the second text of the Waltian canon. Seat 25/03 holds the Epistle to the Human Diaspora in its Critical Edition with Blended Temporal Apparatus (#85), with the Epistle's text from the Seed Text of the New Human Project (#402), since the critical edition's record refers to an earlier version for the text itself. Seat 25/04 holds I Am X… Be Y… Blessed Is the Z…, the Prophetic Catalog, in its Critical Edition with Retrocausal Apparatus (#83). Seat 25/05 holds the Constitution of the Semantic Economy in its Installable Edition with Constitutional Apparatus (#88). Each seat carries the record's canonical bytes, checked against the registry, and the edition as published at secretbookofwalt.org, copied from the site's repository at a pinned commit and checked against its git blobs. The seating brings the shelf to 107 seats.
